QuestInfo.name: Abdullah VIII's Statement
QuestInfo.1: Abdullah VIII seemed very pleased with the turban and told me to send Moren a royal compliment on his behalf. He also said he already gave Moren the reward. That was quick!
QuestInfo.2: I gave Moren the royal compliment that Abdullah VIII made for him. Moren in turn told me how proud he was of the progress I made as an item-producer. As gratifying as it was to receive compliments from someone like Moren, it also put a lot of pressure on me.

0.0: Hmmm... not bad. I like it. How should I say it... it's... refreshing to see something like this. Whatever, I'm too lazy to wait for another one anyway. Good thing I asked Moren for this. Tell him I appreciate his work, and the reward will be sent directly to him.

no.0: Hmm? You want the reward right now? I already have it sent to him.

1.0: Great work, great work. I had been watching you and Keol interact all this time. I was pleasantly surprised that you withstood Keol's snide remarks and worked your way through it. I have to thank you so much for helping us with our work. But I believe it's time for you to spread your wings and part ways with us. You're someone I acknowledge as a great item-producer, so you'll do fine wherever you go. Again, great work.

npc.0: I told you I already sent the fee to Moren. Don't bother me now.
